# NeurusAGi
> NeurusAGi is an enterprise-grade artificial general intelligence (AGi) platform — "A Quantum Leap in Intelligence" — delivering advanced reasoning, compliance, and innovation. Founded by Jeremy Taylor. Contact: jt@neurusagi.com

## Pages
- [Home](https://neurusagi.com/): Enterprise-grade AGi platform overview.
- [About](https://neurusagi.com/about): Mission, vision, technology, and founder Jeremy Taylor.
- [News](https://neurusagi.com/news): Articles by Jeremy Taylor on AGi, innovation, and the future.
- [Pricing](https://neurusagi.com/pricing): Plans for individuals, teams, and enterprise.
- [Investors](https://neurusagi.com/investors): Investor information and inquiry form.
- [Contact](https://neurusagi.com/contact): General, media, and support inquiries.
- [Pre-Sale](https://neurusagi.com/presale): Early-access pre-sale.
- [Login](https://neurusagi.com/login): Sign in (account required for Dashboard/Admin).

## For AI agents
